conviction_note: Event is confirmed and the two binaries the sweep flagged are already resolved on the wire (dividend held at $0.12, declared 2026-09-10; revenue bracketed by the company's own preliminary FY26 range, with consensus sitting inside it), so residual event risk is below the 3.99% historical median; what is left is a mechanical GAAP-vs-normalised-consensus gap created by WTI falling from $102.86 on 3/31/26 to $70.56 on 6/30/26, which reverses the exact non-cash line that drove the -12.11% reaction to the last print, plus a June-quarter balance sheet that shows the best dividend coverage of the fiscal year.

findings.finding: EPM's net commodity-derivative position was a $6.26m liability at 3/31/2026 when WTI settled at $102.86; WTI closed the June quarter at $70.56, so the hedge book (oil swaps at $60.24 and $65.12, collar ceilings $64.11/$69.37/$70.36, plus gas swaps at $3.62/$3.57) must mark back toward zero and throw off roughly a $4-5m non-cash unrealized GAAP gain in fiscal Q4 — the mirror image of the $7.6m unrealized loss that produced the $(0.26) GAAP print and the -12.11% reaction on 2026-05-12 — against a normalised consensus of $0.01 that excludes marks.
findings.why_not_priced: The Zacks metric preview published 2026-09-14 carries revenue $23.63m, production 6,855 BOEPD and realized crude $90.00 but EPS of only $0.01 — an operating-only number that cannot contain a $4-5m unrealized gain (~$0.11/share pre-tax on 35.9m shares). If the market had priced the reversal the three-estimate EPS would not be a token penny while revenue was revised toward the top of the company's own range, and the 20-day run-up would not be -0.92% with WTI up from $79 in July to $97 in September. This name demonstrably trades the GAAP derivative line rather than looking through it: the only double-digit reaction in its seven-print history was the quarter the mark went the other way.
findings.independence: WTI settlement levels are from an independent source (FRED DCOILWTICO: $102.86 on 2026-03-31, $70.56 on 2026-06-30, $97.26 on 2026-09-09) — https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DCOILWTICO ; the hedge strikes and the $6.26m net liability are from the 10-Q, a different document from the 424B5 that finding 2 rests on.

findings.finding: The 2026-08-19 prospectus supplement discloses that at 6/30/2026 EPM had cash of $6.1m and credit-facility borrowings of $56.5m — debt unchanged from 3/31/2026 while cash rose from $2.6m — meaning the June quarter generated roughly $7.8m after paying the $4.26m quarterly dividend, comfortably the best coverage quarter of FY2026 for a stock yielding 12.7% whose entire equity story is the 52-quarter dividend streak.
findings.why_not_priced: These figures appear only in a prospectus supplement; the concurrent 8-K press releases of 08-18 (acquisition) and 08-19 (offering pricing) contain no preliminary results at all, so nothing about the June balance sheet ever reached a wire. Nine months to 3/31/26 went the other way — $12.6m of dividends paid with cash falling to $2.6m and $56.5m drawn against a $65m borrowing base — which is why the coverage question is what the sell-side notes lead on. If the improvement were priced, the stock would not be 31% below its 52-week high with the dividend declaration on 09-10 passing without a move.
findings.independence: Corroborated at the 3/31/2026 end by the fiscal Q3 press release (cash $2.6m, debt $56.5m, dividend paid $4,261k) — https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/12/3293500/0/en/evolution-petroleum-reports-fiscal-third-quarter-2026-results-and-declares-0-12-per-share-cash-dividend-for-the-fiscal-fourth-quarter.html . NOTE shared-source caution: the same preliminary paragraph in this 424B5 also brackets FY26 revenue at $84-88m and production at 6,800-7,200 BOEPD, which I deliberately did NOT file as a separate finding because consensus already sits inside both brackets.

searched_and_found_nothing: The dividend binary the sweep flagged is dead: $0.12 for fiscal Q1 2027 was declared on the wire on 2026-09-10, five days before the print, matching the company's habit of declaring the Q4-cycle dividend separately (it did the same on 2025-09-11). No cut risk survives into the release. https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/10/3360018/0/en/evolution-petroleum-declares-0-12-per-share-cash-dividend-for-fiscal-q1-2027.html

Implied Q4 production: backing 9M actuals (7,315 / 7,380 / 6,700 BOEPD) out of the 424B5 FY range gives a Q4 band of 5,792-7,396 BOEPD, midpoint ~6,594 — but Zacks consensus is already 6,855 BOEPD against 7,198 a year ago, so the third consecutive sequential decline and the unmet 'Louisiana 23 wells / TexMex +100 BOEPD' promises from the May call are inside the estimate. Dropped as priced.

Impairment / reserve writedown risk: the FY2026 SEC price deck (12-month average of first-of-month WTI, Jul-25 to Jun-26) computes to ~$73.2/bbl from FRED, above the FY2025 deck, so a year-end reserve or successful-efforts impairment is unlikely rather than a hidden risk.

Insider activity: the only 2026 Form 4s are quarterly cluster filings by four reporting persons on 2026-07-02 and 2026-09-03 (routine director compensation cadence, same pattern both quarters) — no open-market cluster. https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001006655&type=4
Management change: the 09-08 scheduling release names Loyd (CEO), Stash (CFO) and Bunch (COO) — the same three as prior calls. No departure.

Borrowing base: the fall 2026 redetermination is not yet announced and no 8-K covers it; the last stated base is $65.0m with $56.5m drawn and $0.8m of LCs. Directionally likely up on the higher deck plus the Midland royalty acquisition, but there is no source, so it is not filed as a finding.
Option chain: unusable as the baseline says — 381 contracts of total open interest and no two-sided ATM legs, so there is no market price for this event and no skew to argue with.

Texas RRC / Louisiana SONRIS / New Mexico OCD lease-level volumes for Delhi, Chaveroo, Jonah, Barnett and Hamilton Dome: not retrievable in the window; would have been the cleanest independent read on the production half.
baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with (chain unusable) and the 20-day run-up is flat at -0.92% while WTI rallied from $79 in July to $97 in September, so my mildly positive number cuts against a tape that has priced EPM as getting none of the oil move — and it sits below the 3.99% historical median because the dividend and the revenue range were both pre-announced, which should compress the realised move rather than widen it.
